title: Introduction To Biotechnology
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the same for all organisms."
The four nitrogen bases are the same for all organisms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for many of the normal differences between people such as eye color, hair color, and blood type."
Polymorphisms are responsible for many of the normal differences between people such as eye color, hair color, and blood type.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of tiny building-blocks."
A strand of DNA is made up of tiny building-blocks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for different classes of macromolecules."
Different stains are used for different classes of macromolecules.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a high-cost, low volume affair."
Conventional vaccine production is a high-cost, low volume affair.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a double-helix (like a twisted ladder)."
The shape of the DNA molecule is a double-helix (like a twisted ladder).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a change in DNA, the hereditary material of life."
A mutation is a change in DNA, the hereditary material of life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vast subject and its scope is extended to various branches of biology."
Biotechnology in itself is a vast subject and its scope is extended to various branches of biology.
fib: ______ refer to these using four letters, A, T, G, and C.
Scientists usually
Scientists usually refer to these using four letters, A, T, G, and C.
______ is a mutation that exchanges one base for another (i.e., a change in a single "chemical letter" such as switching an A to a G).
substitution
Substitution A substitution is a mutation that exchanges one base for another (i.e., a change in a single "chemical letter" such as switching an A to a G).
______ is a tightly folded bundle of DNA.
chromosome
A chromosome is a tightly folded bundle of DNA.
______ is an animal whose hereditary DNA has been augmented by addition of DNA from a source other than parental germplasm through recombinant DNA techniques.
transgenic animal
Transgenic animals A transgenic animal is an animal whose hereditary DNA has been augmented by addition of DNA from a source other than parental germplasm through recombinant DNA techniques.
______ is the process where DNA makes a copy of itself.
Replication
Replication is the process where DNA makes a copy of itself.
______ is the general name for taking a piece of one DNA, and combining it with another strand of DNA.
Recombinant DNA
Recombinant DNA is the general name for taking a piece of one DNA, and combining it with another strand of DNA.
______ is a portion of a single DNA molecule containing over 4.6 million base pairs encoding approximately 4,300 genes.
tangle
The tangle is a portion of a single DNA molecule containing over 4.6 million base pairs encoding approximately 4,300 genes.
______ is a long, but narrow string-like object.
DNA
DNA is a long, but narrow string-like object.
According to the course material, how many forms of indigenous lactic acid bacteria are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two forms of indigenous lactic acid bacteria: the homofermentative type which converts hexose sugars to lactic acid with no loss of dry matter and the heterofermentative type which produces a range of compounds accompanied by loss of dry matter as carbon dioxide.
